Open Undersea Cable Map

519 cable-system networks with explicit landing membership

License, attribution, and processing

  • License: CC-BY-NC-SA-3.0
  • Attribution: TeleGeography and Steve Song.
  • Citation: TeleGeography submarine cable map data, republished by Steve Song in Open Undersea Cable Map commit e7903491e73bcac0d0b013b945897d10928483c4.
  • Modifications: CommunicationNetworkDatasets.jl normalized the source records into a simple undirected graph, normalized identifiers and units, and rendered this plot over raster basemap tiles.
  • Use and redistribution: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0; the artifact and derived documentation retain attribution noncommercial and share-alike terms.
  • Basemap: Protomaps © OpenStreetMap contributors; hosted by QuantumSavory.
